acceptanceCriteria: A CAL-V0-236 test asserts which replay route (complete route vs writer-checkpoint route) served each superseded replay, and fails if one route stops emitting the advisory warning.
A PSR-V0-022 test over a full sweep asserts the probe invocation count: an unproved-cleanup probe after a retryable exit class launches no further attempt.
internal/tasks/service and internal/tasks/scale pass at the PR #927 merge commit.
body: Residual from the V1-1402/1406 lane (PR #927, head b0f5cbe24, merge-base 0d9a9ca08; darwin go1.27.2). (1) TestCALV0236_SupersededReplayCarriesAdvisoryWarning uses the same route switch as the accepted CAL-V0-230/231 tests but does not observe which route served the replay. (2) TestPSRV0022_UnprovedProbeCleanupRecordsUnknown covers the classifier and runner Bound; no full-sweep invocation-count test proves terminal behaviour end to end (Codex suggestion). (3) service and scale packages passed only before the Codex-fix commits. Expected: route and invocation counts observed; actual: inferred from the switch and the classifier table.
title: tests: CAL-V0-236 replay route not observed; PSR-V0-022 lacks full-sweep invocation count; service/scale not rerun after #927 fixes
